reviews.verdict: No reconsideration from this shard. §12.5.6.4 explicitly imposes both flags on Text annotations, and prior text_annotation_spec_audit covers the implementation geometry.

reviews.topic: Popup is a separate window, not page appearance
reviews.verdict: Supported. Primary EC3 §12.5.6.14 p.495 says no AP/actions and describes the editing window; actual model and public Query::Popups tests exercise the split.

reviews.topic: PrinterMark/TrapNet must be visible under conforming F flags
reviews.verdict: Supported. §14.11.3 p.819 and §14.11.6.2 p.826 explicitly set Print+ReadOnly and all other flags clear. The integration test uses F=68 and checks both screen and print output.

reviews.topic: Subtype-wide handler sweep, PrinterMark/TrapNet stored AP, Watermark FixedPrint
reviews.verdict: The current specific tests materially support the AP and FixedPrint branches. The generic Table 171 population assertion is only a dispatch/catch-all guard and should not be cited as visual behavior; no contrary implementation finding.

reviews.topic: Table 403 stale TrapNet tracking fields are writer-side or reader obligations
reviews.verdict: Keep as an open interpretation rather than repeating the current ledger's certainty. §14.11.6.2 p.826 explicitly assigns verification to a PDF writer generating a new network, then uses passive 'Any trap networks found to be invalid shall be regenerated' and a condition on LastModified. Regeneration appears to construct trapping marks, which is not performed here; however the subject of the latter shall is not explicit. The current ADR1035 correctly recorded that the source/reader boundary still needs adjudication. No new code/test change is supported by this shard.

reviews.topic: Watermark geometry, screen media, and interactivity exclusion
reviews.verdict: Supported by direct source text and current assertion bodies. Keep the known page-media / FixedPrint evidence separate from blanket claims about all tiled/n-up combinations.

reviews.topic: Projection appearance exception and out-of-context behavior
reviews.verdict: The #94 annotation adds 'and thus an AP dictionary is not required' at physical 520 / printed 505. Stored AP dispatch is generic; AP absence returns Nothing. Existing tests prove the no-catch-all path, not valid 3D runtime measurement behavior. Do not extend this result into clause 13.

why_no_new_draft: Current focused assertions cover the source-derived, observable reader behavior in this assignment: Popup display flags and public window query; PrinterMark/TrapNet named appearance selection and View/Print behavior; Watermark default FixedPrint values, output placement, no pointer/popup; and Projection's no-AP dispatch. A missing valid-runtime Projection fixture and TrapNet regeneration test would need out-of-scope production/editor behavior, so drafting them would either assert policy or violate the valid-producer control requirement.
